market.what: LOHC carrier liquids (DBT, toluene/MCH, carbazoles) sold to pilots and first plants, world
market.method: est.: ~1-3 kt/yr fills (Hynertech phase 1 1,000 t/yr; Hydrogenious, Chiyoda) x ~$5-10/kg. Reports $1.0-1.85B count plants and look inflated

value.logic: DBT needs 65 kJ/mol H2 (~27% of H2 LHV) at ~300C; carrier at ~45 kJ/mol saves 10 MJ/kg = 8% of H2 burned for heat; est. 1 Mt/yr LOHC trade x $5/kg x 8%; more if release runs on <200C waste heat
value.revenue_logic: est. 2033 LOHC ~0.15 Mt H2/yr; ~16 kg carrier/kg H2 per trip, ~10 trips/yr -> ~50 kt/yr new fill; 10% share x $6/kg
value.margin_logic: carrier is a bulk fine chemical; inventory sale once per plant, small make-up; license fee would lift it

trend.drivers: EU/Japan/Korea H2 imports; port projects (Rotterdam); China LOHC scale-up; but IEA cut 2030 electrolyzer outlook
trend.deadline: EU RED III: 42% RFNBO share of industrial H2 by 2030

competition.paper_query: liquid organic hydrogen carrier dehydrogenation enthalpy
competition.notes: Hydrogenious ~$99M raised, EUR17M Feb 2025 + EUR72.5M grant; HySiLabs EUR13M A; Ayrton $6.8M seed; Hynertech plans 1 Mt/yr carrier, RMB 3B

lab.synth: catalog or 1-2 step custom N-heterocycles/aromatics; 3 variants, 20-50 g each
lab.test: autoclave hydrogenation (Ru) + dehydrogenation (Pt/Pd) at 180-250C with H2 flow metering, GC/NMR degree of H2 release, DSC for reaction heat; university catalysis lab
lab.logic: synth 4 wk + cycling tests 8 wk; synth ~$15k + reactor time/analysis ~$20k

sale.gates: REACH registration 1-10 t/yr; tox and flash-point data for shipping; 1-2 yr pilot with a LOHC operator; catalyst match
